newsitem.title: UK: Bass edges lower amid thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Bass edges lower amid thin volume.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc backtracked gently during Tuesday's morning session in low turnover amid talk of a single seller in the market, dealers said.
Bass shares were down 5.5 pence, or 0.69 percent, to 795p by 0840 GMT in volume of 400,000 while the FTSE-100 index was 13.5 points, or 0.31 percent, higher at 4403.2.
"There was talk of someone selling a quarter (of a million shares) at 98 (798p)," a marketmaker at a British bank said. Another trader said: "Five pence off an eight pound stock is no great shakes."
The breweries, pubs and restaurants sector was otherwise quiet.
